**Live data since ${go_live}; earlier history was imported.** Flights from 24-08-2025 to 06-03-2026 and controller sessions from 24-08-2025 to 15-03-2026 come from the previous system (no speed, altitude or SELCAL for imported flights). There are no flights after 06-03-2026 and no controller sessions after 15-03-2026 until ${go_live}. Panels for the last 7 or 30 days and the live tables show current data only. All times are UTC.

panels.title: Where pilots currently online come from
panels.description: Home region of the pilots online now.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT region, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM pilot_online_now
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY pilots DESC

panels.title: Who flies most in Australian airspace: flights by home region (last 30 days)
panels.description: Flights per pilot home region over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pilot_region AS region, count(*) AS flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY pilot_region
ORDER BY flights DESC

panels.title: Who spends most time in Australian airspace: airborne hours by home region (last 30 days)
panels.description: Airborne hours per pilot home region over the last 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pilot_region AS region, round((sum(airborne_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS hours
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY pilot_region
ORDER BY hours DESC

panels.title: Flights by joining cohort (CID range, last 30 days)
panels.description: Flights and distinct pilots by CID range over the last 30 days, a rough guide to when pilots joined.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (split_part(cohort, '-', 1)::bigint / 10000)::text || '-' AS cohort,
       count(*) AS flights,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM cohorts
WHERE end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY cid_group, cohort
ORDER BY cid_group

panels.title: Servers used by home-region pilots (last 24 hours)
panels.description: Home-region pilots on each network server over the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(server, 'Unknown') AS server, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.pilot_is_local
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY pilots DESC

panels.title: Active pilots and controllers (last 90 days, log scale)
panels.description: Pilots (30+ minutes airborne) and controllers by rating (30+ minute sessions) over the last 90 days, on a log scale.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label, people FROM (
  SELECT -100 AS sort, 'Pilots' AS label, count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS people
  FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND f.airborne_minutes >= 30
  UNION ALL
  SELECT min(r.rating) AS sort, r.label, count(DISTINCT r.cid) AS people
  FROM (
    SELECT c.rating, c.cid,
           CASE c.rating WHEN 1 THEN 'Obs' WHEN 2 THEN 'S1' WHEN 3 THEN 'S2' WHEN 4 THEN 'S3' WHEN 5 THEN 'C1'
                         WHEN 6 THEN 'C2' WHEN 7 THEN 'C3' WHEN 8 THEN 'I1' WHEN 9 THEN 'I2' WHEN 10 THEN 'I3'
                         WHEN 11 THEN 'Supervisor' WHEN 12 THEN 'Administrator' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS label
    FROM controller_session_ranked c
    WHERE (c.session_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() OR c.session_end BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo())
      AND c.duration_minutes >= 30
  ) r
  GROUP BY r.label
) x
ORDER BY sort
